description: Newly woken on the meadow with his name still on him, which is rarer than it sounds. What he was is over; what he will be has not been decided yet.
lore: He woke in the meadow grass with his name still on him, which is rarer than it sounds, and [[characters/6bb1eb5a|Solveig]] was beside him before the dew had soaked through his shirt. She told him the truth once, plainly, and asked his name and one true thing. The name came easily. The true thing took him until sundown — it was small, and she thanked him for it as if he had paid a debt, because here a true thing said aloud is exactly that.

He still checks his pockets for something he last had on the other side. They are empty. So were everyone's — arriving with nothing is the one experience this whole country shares, and it is why a stranger here will feed you before you ask.

There is nothing remarkable about him, and this is not modesty: quick hands, a stubborn streak he had before the end, and no idea yet what either is for. Solveig is unworried. The ones who thank her, she says, always turn up at the meadow again sooner or later — on the far side of the courtesy, walking out into the wet grass to meet somebody new.
gm_notes: Player-surrogate: the only committed facts are the recent waking, the kept name, and being met by Solveig — chapter-1 events every player has. All v1 star imagery purged (arrival is the Waking). The close seeds the long arc of players becoming keepers themselves.
